POS-5b29a40a7b6e.title: Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in Rehabilitation and Exercise Therapy
POS-5b29a40a7b6e.institution: CDUTCM-Keele Joint Health and Medical Sciences Institute
POS-5b29a40a7b6e.summary: This position involves teaching rehabilitation and exercise therapy, providing academic support, and building a research profile. Key responsibilities include delivering classes, supervising student projects, and contributing to academic development. Candidates must hold a Master's degree or PhD in a related field, possess higher education teaching experience, and demonstrate an active research profile.

POS-c1acac7174d5.title: Assistant Professor in Mobility Justice: Equity & Mobilities
POS-c1acac7174d5.deadline_evidence: Applications should be received prior to November 30, 2026.
POS-c1acac7174d5.summary: Simon Fraser University invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant Professor position in Mobility Justice: Equity & Mobilities within the Urban Studies Program. Candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant discipline. Responsibilities include conducting research, teaching undergraduate and graduate courses, and graduate student supervision.
